$meta.artifact: N.E.R.D. — AppSheet vendor-level Resources table: structure + content snapshot
$meta.purpose: Completes the table family documented in nerd_appsheet_vendor_supports_table.json's $meta.table_family, which listed "Vendor Resources (31 rows, screenshot)" as already captured on 2026-08-18 but for which no corresponding JSON artifact was ever produced. This file fills that gap using a fresh screenshot.

inputs.covers: all 31 rows, all columns except Row ID and full URL text
inputs.fidelity: Row text is NOT truncated in this capture (no trailing ellipsis observed in any cell) -- differs from the 2026-08-18 batch. However the URL column renders as a link-launch icon only; no URL text is visible or recoverable from this screenshot for any row.

inputs.covers: Row IDs (AppSheet UNIQUEID) for all 31 rows, via element id="Table_RowElement_Vendor_Resource_<row_id>"
inputs.fidelity: complete and exact -- these are DOM attribute values, not OCR/transcription. Confirmed 31 distinct keys, no duplicates.

inputs.covers: Full, untruncated URL column for all 31 rows (wider column capture than the 4:21 PM screenshot)
inputs.fidelity: High confidence on most rows. Medium confidence on rows with long alphanumeric IDs (Microsoft support anchor hashes, YouTube video IDs, Google answer sjid param) -- see per-row _url_transcription_confidence flags on ui_row 14, 15, 21, 24, 27.

$meta.truncation_meaning: Not applicable to this capture -- no cell values were visually truncated. Retained for schema consistency with sibling artifacts.
$meta.row_key: row_id (AppSheet UNIQUEID, 22 chars) -- VERIFIED via DOM element id attribute (Table_RowElement_Vendor_Resource_<key>), not screenshot OCR

completeness.basis: Matches the row count (31) pre-reported in nerd_appsheet_vendor_supports_table.json's table_family.captured_so_far, and no scroll/pagination affordance is visible below the last row.

$meta.relationship_to_other_tables: This is the VENDOR-level Resources table -- vendor_reference stores a vendor NAME matching Vendors.vendor_name, the same join convention as Products.vendor_id and Supports(vendor-level).vendor_id. It is structurally parallel to, and distinct from, the product-level Resources table (nerd_appsheet_product_resources_table.json, ~281 rows, of which 89 are captured) -- same column family (name/url/source/label/datetime/added_to_site), scoped by vendor instead of by product.
known_gaps: Column order in the live UI (Name, Added to Site?, URL, Source, Label, Vendor Reference, Last Updated) differs from the product-level Resources table's captured order (Name, Product Reference, URL, Source, Label, ...) -- Vendor Reference sits near the end here rather than 2nd position. Recorded as observed; does not necessarily imply anything about backend field order.
data_anomalies: ui_row 22 ('Thoughts on I-Ready') has Source=External but an EMPTY Vendor Reference -- the only row where Source is populated but Vendor Reference is not.

ui_row 6 ('Accessibility Statement', BrainPop) and ui_row 27 ('Accessibility Settings (Video)', edclub) have no Added to Site? value (neither Y nor N) -- blank/tri-state, not a checked or unchecked box. ui_row 6 also has no Last Updated timestamp, consistent with being an untouched/draft row.

Three rows share the Name 'Accessibility Statement' (ui_row 6 / BrainPop, ui_row 26 / ExploreLearning, ui_row 31 / Capstone) -- distinct count on name is 29, not 31. Not an error; vendors commonly reuse this generic title.

DATETIME FORMAT DISCREPANCY WITH PRIOR ARTIFACTS: this table's datetime values use 'M/D/YYYY h:mm:ss AM/PM' (4-digit year, seconds included -- e.g. '2/17/2026 9:35:34 AM'), matching the Products table's format. Every other child table captured so far (Resources/product-level, both Supports tables, Vendors) used 'M/D/YY, h:mm AM/PM' (2-digit year, no seconds). nerd_appsheet_product_supports_table.json's $meta claimed 'Products remains the sole outlier' on this point -- that claim is now contradicted; Products and vendor-level Resources share the long format, everything else captured so far uses the short format.

ui_row 2 ('Accessibility Community') and ui_row 3 ('Accessibility Toolkit') have IDENTICAL urls (https://community.instructure.com/en/categories/accessibility). Recorded as observed -- may be a legitimate shared landing page (a forum category) rather than a data entry error.

row_key_verification.method: All 31 row_id values were cross-checked for overlap against the union of resource_ids across all 101 rows in nerd_appsheet_products_table.json (281 distinct keys).
row_key_verification.result: Zero overlap. Confirms this table's rows are NOT the ones Products.resource_ids points at -- consistent with this being the separate vendor-level Resources table, parallel to (not the same as) the product-level Resources table that Products.resource_ids actually targets.
row_key_verification.note: This does not verify individual row_id correctness (no parent pointer exists to check against, unlike ACRs), only that the table-level relationship claimed in $meta.relationship_to_other_tables is not contradicted by the data.
